rules.title: Cambridge Fair Housing Ordinance
rules.requirement: Landlords, sellers and rental agents in Cambridge may not discriminate against housing applicants based on source of income, including Section 8 vouchers and other public benefits, among other protected categories.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to rental housing transactions in Cambridge, including viewing or renting an apartment and terms and conditions of tenancy; exemption for 2-family dwellings when the owner lives there.
rules.exemptions: 2-family dwellings, when the owner lives there
rules.quoted_span: Source of Income, includes Section 8 and public benefits
